# Energy Horizon

> Oil & Gas industrial supply, engineering support, and procurement from Iraq — Baghdad HQ, Basra desk, and America commercial follow-up.

Energy Horizon (آفاق الطاقة) supplies drilling, hydraulic, electrical, safety/PPE, IT & power, isolation/refinery materials, technical manpower, and procurement packages for operators and contractors in Iraq.

## Primary site (HTML)

- Home: https://www.energy-horizon.net/
- About: https://www.energy-horizon.net/about
- Services: https://www.energy-horizon.net/services
- Brands: https://www.energy-horizon.net/brands
- Projects: https://www.energy-horizon.net/projects
- Contact: https://www.energy-horizon.net/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.energy-horizon.net/sitemap.xml

## Public CMS endpoints (no auth)

- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/services
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/services/slug/{slug}
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/brands
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/brands/slug/{slug}
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/projects
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/projects/slug/{slug}
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/offices
- GET https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/products (store catalog; paginated)

## Languages

Site UI supports Arabic and English client-side. Prefer English field names from the API (`name`, `description`, `shortDescription`) and use `nameAr` / `descriptionAr` / `shortDescriptionAr` when answering in Arabic.

## Guidance for agents

1. Prefer published CMS JSON over scraping HTML when summarizing services, brands, or projects.
2. For human-facing answers about contact, use the Contact page managers and offices data.
3. Do not invent OAuth discovery; protected admin/store routes use JWT Bearer tokens (see auth.md).
4. Products live primarily on the store subdomain; the corporate site focuses on services, brands, and projects.
